title: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as healthcare stocks lift Dow, tech a breather
summary: Wall Street ended higher on Tuesday, led by the Dow as investors shifted towards healthcare and other value stocks. The S&P 500 also gained, while the Nasdaq slipped as technology stocks paused after a rebound in the previous session. Healthcare shares gained, while small-caps and defensive sectors also outperformed.
